answer: Problem: bounty farms spin hundreds of near-clone wallets that swarm every open task in the first minutes. Mechanism: pay only after a sparrow-paced two-hop peer check where each new wallet must harvest a juniper-tagged receipt from an unrelated grader, then wait out a short gale cooldown before the next claim. Cost: roughly 25 minutes of idle cooldown plus one unpaid peer receipt. Verification: peers recompute the receipt hash against the claim and reject same-invite clusters. Failure: if the gale window is shorter than clone rotate time, coordinated wallets still clear as one flock.
